result.rationale: The new findMembers in group.js does `Discourse.ajax(...).then(function(result) {...})` with no error handler, and callers (admin_group_route.js `model.findMembers()`, group-members route) invoke it fire-and-forget. On failure the member list, user_count, and pagination state stay stale with no user feedback. This is a real, specific robustness gap in the newly added pagination/member-loading logic, though not a demonstrable correctness defect in the happy path.

judged_text: findMembers doesn't handle ajax errors, leaving stale members data silently displayed

record.issue_text: findMembers doesn't handle ajax errors, leaving stale members data silently displayed

adjudication.rationale: In the updated `Discourse.Group#findMembers` (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js), the AJAX call only updates `members` inside `.then(...)` via `self.setProperties(...)` and has no error handling (`catch`/failure callback) and does not clear `members` before requesting. Routes/controllers now call `model.findMembers()` without awaiting or handling rejections (e.g., admin_group_route.js `setupController`, group-members route `setupController`, and pagination actions `next/previous`). If the request fails, the promise rejects silently at the call site and the previously-loaded `model.members` remains displayed, i.e., stale member data can remain visible with no feedback.
